desc:
Step into the ultimate test of skill and nerve! This is not your typical round — it's an intense, head-to-head showdown where only the best shooter and the quickest slasher will survive.

Traitor Duels pits players against each other in fast-paced, high-stakes matches. Forget the crowd; it's just you, your opponent, and the adrenaline of a guaranteed confrontation.

Sheriff Role: Sharpen your aim! You have one shot to take down the Murderer before they get close enough to strike. Precision is everything.

Murderer Role: Master the knife throw! Close the distance and eliminate your target with swiftness and deadly accuracy. Timing is crucial.
